gripOrHq.title: Highlighter
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

gripOrHq.title: Disintegrator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [2]: Derez a piece of ice and end your run. Use this ability only when you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice and have successfully passed it.

gripOrHq.title: Redecorator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break up to two sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [3]: +1 strength

gripOrHq.title: Taxman
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Tax counter. Every two Tax counters cause the Corp to lose [1] at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

gripOrHq.title: Sunburst Cranial Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Put [1] from the bank on Cranial Interface when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.
